events.title: Paint & Sip
events.description: Moonlit MushroomsA little magical, a little moody, and seriously fun to paint. Join us for an evening escape at Crooked Lane as we create Moonlit Mushrooms—a whimsical cluster of bright red mushrooms glowing beneath a starry midnight sky.We’ll walk you through the painting step-by-step, from the dramatic black background and glowing moon to those classic red-and-white mushroom caps and lush woodland greenery. Make it just like the original or add your own enchanted touches!🎨 What’s Included: • Step-by-step instruction — beginners absolutely welcome! • All painting supplies included • Your own finished canvas to take home • Food and drinks available for purchase at Crooked Lane • A relaxed and fun evening of painting, sipping & treating yourself to a creative escapeCome with friends, make it a date night, or fly solo and meet some fellow creative people. These magical little mushrooms won’t be hanging around forever—grab your seat before this one disappears into the forest. 🌙✨ https://sips.art/products/moonlit-mushrooms-crooked-lane-weds-sept-16th-6p (Recurring: Does not Repeat)

events.title: Freemont Sierra Expedition
events.description: Auburn State Theatre Features History Expedition Presents… Fremont Sierra Expedition Men, animals, and supplies were pushed to the edge as they fought deep snow, bitter wind, and unforgiving elevation in one of the harshest crossings of the entire journey. Our Expeditions team tested Frémont’s legend against the realities of snowpack, altitude, and human endurance. Step by step, we’re asking how much of his famous narrative the land itself is willing to confirm.Join the intrepid History Expedition team for a post‑expedition presentation to see what we discovered—where the Pathfinder’s story holds, where it fractures, and what it feels like to shoulder his route in the present day. To dive deeper into the history, maps, and upcoming film work, visit www.Historyexp.orgCome enjoy a taste of Crooked Lane’s special craft brew created for this event, “The Pathfinder”, as you enjoy a most entertaining evening about a remarkable America West story, inspiring people and with breathtaking imagery of the Sierra.Running time: approx. 2h (Recurring: Does not Repeat)
